advisors.name: Dr. Kenneth Starkman
advisors.bio: Dr. Kenneth Starkman is Dean of the Technology and Engineering Division at Fullerton College and serves as AEC's project advisor. He has led regional Strong Workforce initiatives spanning cybersecurity, construction, and advanced transportation, and was recognized as the Faculty Senate's 2024 Administrator of the Year for his work supporting faculty and students.

advisors.name: Dr. Carlos Aguirre
advisors.bio: Dr. Carlos Aguirre is Director of the STEM Center and Academic Support Programs (MESA) at Fullerton College, where he builds community and mentorship for students pursuing STEM fields. He holds a bachelor's in pharmaceutical sciences from UC Irvine and a master's and doctorate from The Scripps Research Institute, with prior experience at NASA's Office of STEM Engagement.
